title: GEMglTexEnvi

messages.description: symbolic name of a single-valued texture environment parameter
texture environment value, e.g. GL_MODULATE, GL_DECAL or GL_REPLACE

arguments.description: symbolic name of a single-valued texture environment parameter
texture environment value, e.g. GL_MODULATE, GL_DECAL or GL_REPLACE

body: [GEMglTexEnvi] calls glTexEnvi() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glTexEnv in the OpenGL reference.
